review.review_note: Brief CXLVII (protocol LF31656, closing LF31827–31830 dated 21 August 1837) is a complete papal brief whose dispositive part is nine numbered laws. Paragraph numerals 2. and 3. are not extracted in order: LF31720 Religiosi Scholarum (law 2) begins at the hanging-text indent with no native XML WORD at the numeral position, and the numeral of law 3 is emitted as the OCR token as (LF31733, native box x1538–1572 on the baseline of LF31729 Quoad vero, y3330–3366) after the column’s last line. The registered whole-volume archive.org PDF https://archive.org/download/actagregoriipapa0002vinc/actagregoriipapa0002vinc.pdf (SHA256 57363d1df0589817da474caaedc50e43bdc3bb03706fa676b8fc1caeb818f0b0, cached copy in .scratch/coverage_audit) artifact page 224, rendered locally at 360 dpi into this lane (pages/pdfpage-224.png) (crop pages/crop-p224-cxlvii-laws.png) prints 2. and 3. at the start of those paragraphs. constituents.review_note: CXLVIII is headed DZCRETUM (LF31837). The Sacred Congregation of Bishops and Regulars, ex speciali facultate sibi tributa, praises and approves the institute (LF31951–31960) after the pope, in an audience reported in the third person (Et ita iussit Sanctitas Sua in audientia … die quarta augusti, LF31945–31950), ordered a decree of praise; dated Rome ex s. congregatione 5 August 1837 (LF31962–31964) and subscribed I. A. card. Sala praef. and J. Patriarcha CP. secretarius (LF31967–31970). A curial decree, not an independently authored papal act. Its provenance LF31859 and page/running-title furniture LF31893 and LF31946 are not part of it; the edition’s note 2 (Leo XII) is reviewed separately.

constituents.review_note: The edition’s note 2 to decree CXLVIII transcribes a letter to Jean-Pierre de Gallien de Chabons, bishop of Amiens (address LF31860–31863), commending Marie-Madeleine d’Houët’s institute, dated Rome 2 August 1826, pontificatus Nostri anno III (LF32035–32036). It is printed at the feet of artifact pages 225–226 and closes inside letter CXLIX. Its issuer is Leo XII, not Gregory XVI, and its protocol line is garbled in OCR (GEOZER sil:, LF31866), so the issuer cannot be pinned by a literal attribution locus in this witness. Held for coordinator disposition; not selected into any Gregory XVI act.

constituents.review_note: Gregory’s confirmation is independently identifiable at1244–1352, dated24March1840, followed by the substantive general-chapter prescriptions1355–1447 and approved rule1454–6179. The complete printed confirmation-with-annex witness remains held because annex heading words are truly misordered: DE VOTIS4255 is physically on native leaf37 at y3058–3082 before ET EORUM EXSOLUTIONE4246 and §I/De votis generatim4252, yet emitted after them; native leaf47 places CONSTITOUTIS5714 on the APUD HAERETICOS AUT INFIDELES5704 heading line, before ET MISSIONIBUS5705 and §I/Praescripta generalia5711, yet emits it below5711. Whole leaf images37/47 were viewed and pinned. These are normative annex headings, not Bernasconi publishing furniture. No source-supported ordered derivative has been created. Do not admit only a clean brief subrange as a historical fragment to bypass its appended rule. Conversely, the odd closing tibus qui tificatus1352 is actually printed on whole native leaf18 and is not an order defect; it must remain literal. The annexes are authored by the congregation/general chapters, not independently authored papal acts.

Et primum audiantur accusatores,”. Including LF63905 in place misorders the normative text; omitting it drops it. No ordered derivative exists. constituents.review_note: Apostolic letter CCCLXI (intitulation LF67575–67576, body LF67579–67749, dating clause 3 April 1846 LF67750–67753; furniture: heading LF67566–67572, running titles LF67604 and LF67694, provenance note1 LF67658–67659, folio LF67756) confirms the Turin institute of the Sisters of St Anne founded by the Marchioness Giulia Falletti di Barolo “una cum constitutionibus” and approves its constitutions and rules (LF67652–67703). The edition prints in the foot band of leaf 486 the confirming DECRETUM of the Congregation of Bishops and Regulars (LF67662–67691, part02) and immediately after the brief the Italian “COSTITUZIONI E REGOLE DELL’ISTITUTO DELLE SUORE DI S. ANNA DELLA PROVVIDENZA” (LF67759–75685, part03). Following the coordinator’s ruling for CVIII (volume-03-b01/b02: a brief with its appended rule is held as one compound printed witness, after the Sacratissimorum Cordium precedent), the compound witness is held and a clean brief subrange is not admitted to bypass it. Independently, the appended rule carries an exact reading-order defect that blocks admission of the compound: on native leaf 495 the right-column chapter heading “Trroro XVI. / ; Del silenzio.” (LF68913–68914, XML x1669–1948 y350–394 and x1401–1945 y466–515) is emitted between the left-column lines LF68908 “… (Questa regola” (y449–508) and LF68918 “non € punto fatta per I’ insigne fondatrice …” (y506–559), inside one sentence of art. 104. No ordered derivative exists. The compound witness would be bilingual (Latin brief, Italian rule with Latin prayers). If the coordinator rules the rule a separate document, the brief alone is admit-ready as [[67575, 67603], [67607, 67655], [67697, 67753]] (excluding the running titles LF67604/LF67694, provenance LF67658–67659 and the curial decree LF67662–67691).

XVI, attentis litteris commendatitiis … auditisque nonnullis S.R.E. cardinalibus ex Ss. congregatione Episcoporum et Regularium delectis …” approved and confirmed the institute and its rules (LF67665–67676), communicated the indulgences of the Society of the Sacred Heart and ordered “ut praesens decretum per literas apostolicas in forma Brevis expediatur” (LF67682–67684); dated “Datum Romae ex s. congregatione Episcoporum et Regularium die 8 martii 1846.” (LF67686–67687) and subscribed by the cardinal prefect and the secretary, archbishop of Perge (LF67690–67691). The pope is reported in the third person; the actual issuer is the Congregation of Bishops and Regulars, as for the comparable decrees in this series. Not an independently authored papal act.

constituents.review_note: Printed CXXVIII (numeral read ‘CXXVIn)’ LF73578; index CXXVIII. LF101718) is a genuine papal act: editorial caption LF73581–73584, label LF73587 ‘CHIROGRAFO PONTIFICIO’, address LF73590–73591 ‘Monsignor Antonio Tosti Nostro tesoriere generale.’, first-person papal narrative (Ci rappresentaste … LF73594 ff.), the eight massime LF73723–73859, dispositive clause (Col presente chirografo … di nostro motu-proprio, certa scienza, e colla pienezza della nostra apostolica e sovrana autorità, ordiniamo ed ingiungiamo LF73881–73896), derogations LF74006–74032, dating clause LF74034–74035 ‘Dato dal nostro palazzo apostolico al Vati- cano questo di 10 gennaio 1835.’ and papal subscription LF74038 ‘GREGORIUS PP. XVI.’. The whole instrument and 20+ LF of context each side were read literally. HOLD for its annex: the chirograph incorporates the TARIFFA generale delle monete as part of the act (quale vogliamo che sia allegata, e si abbia come se fosse qui di parola in parola trascritta LF73874–73879; la suddetta e qui sotto esposta tariffa LF73907–73908; Approvando finalmente la nuova tariffa LF73959–73976), and the edition prints it after the subscription as TARIFFA DELLE MONETE DI ORO DI ARGENTO E DI RAME (LF74041–74295, leaves 479–482). That annex is a multi-column table whose OCR interleaves state labels, row labels, column heads and cell values: native XML of leaf 479 emits the column head STATI (LF74067) after DELLE MONETE (y back-jump), and the row value ‘due e mezzo’ (LF74107, bbox [985,2966,1231,2997]) after the last row LF74104 although it belongs beside Moneta da scudi … cinque (LF74079); leaf 480 fuses state labels into row lines (e.g. LF74147–74148 ‘GRAN DUCATO … DI TOSCANA {’, LF74158–74159 ‘IMPERO … AUSTRIACO’) and puts LF74189 on the same baseline as LF74186; leaves 479–481 do not align exactly with the XML, and cell values are illegible (e.g. LF74123, LF74128, LF74130). Ordered nonoverlapping LF ranges cannot give the annex in reading order, and excluding it would omit a substantive annex the act incorporates, so the complete chirograph stays held (not a fragment). The chirograph body itself (leaves 476–479 top) shows no reading-order flag; on a future admission the numeral, caption, running titles (LF73618, 73686, 73920, 73989), page numbers (LF73758, 73848, 74015) would be excludable furniture.

review.review_note: Printed instrument CXLVII (LF83886–84509) is issued by Anton-Domenico Gamberini, cardinal segretario per gli affari di Stato interni (Secretariat for Internal Affairs of State). Numeral LF83886 “CXLVII.”. Dating clause LF84505–84506: “Dalla Segreteria per gli affari di Stato in- terni li 10 giugno 1837.”. Subscription LF84509–84509: “A. D. Card. Gamperint.”. Papal context or mandate (la Santità di Nostro Signore … ordered/approved/ratified, inteso l’oracolo, nel sovrano suo nome, ci ha comandato di pubblicare) does not make this curial/civil instrument an independently authored papal act; it has no papal protocol, papal first person or papal subscription. NOTIFICAZIONE LF83895, intitulation LF83898–83901. By order of Gregory XVI (reported in the third person, LF83941–83950) the secretary republishes, nested inside his notificazione: the notificazione of 10 January 1818 of Cesare Guerrieri, tesoriere generale (LF83964–83997 and LF84425–84451, subscribed CESARE GUERRIERI LF84449–84451), which itself inserts the chirograph of Pius VII of 8 January 1818 (LF84000–84422: address to mons. Cesare Guerrieri, regolamento, dating clause LF84418–84419 and subscription LF84422 'Prus Papa VII.'), followed by the excerpted articles 27–31 of the regolamento of 1 December 1817 (LF84454–84503). The only papal act in this printed instrument is that earlier chirograph of Pius VII, republished here as an insert; it is not an act of Gregory XVI and is not admitted to this series (catalog lead only). LF84512 (scan-edge noise, XML bbox [2579,0,2595,54]) and LF84515 (running title) follow the subscription and precede printed CXLVIII.

review.review_note: Printed instrument CXLIX (LF85192–86446) is issued by Anton-Domenico Gamberini, cardinal segretario per gli affari di Stato interni (Secretariat for Internal Affairs of State). Numeral LF85192 “(Gill”. Dating clause LF85370–85371: “Dalla Segreteria per gli affari di Stato interni il di 8 maggio 1838.”. Subscription LF85374–85374: “A. D. card. GAMBERINI.”. Papal context or mandate (la Santità di Nostro Signore … ordered/approved/ratified, inteso l’oracolo, nel sovrano suo nome, ci ha comandato di pubblicare) does not make this curial/civil instrument an independently authored papal act; it has no papal protocol, papal first person or papal subscription. Numeral CXLIX. read as '(Gill' (LF85192, native XML bbox [1695,318,1790,355], centred above the intitulation; the edition prints no caption here, the index has CIL. LF101886). Intitulation LF85195–85198; inteso l’oracolo della viva voce della stessa Santità Sua si prescrive (LF85222–85224); arts. 1–12, dated and subscribed LF85370–85374. It continues with the REGOLAMENTO E SOVRANA AUTORIZZAZIONE DELLA PRIVILEGIATA SOCIETÀ PONTIFICIA DI ASSICURAZIONI (LF85377–86416, capitoli I–V, arts. 1–83) and the recorded sovereign authorization LF86419–86446: '66731. Dall’ udienza di nostro Signore li 28 ottobre 1837. — La Santità di nostro Signore … si è degnata di approvare …' subscribed A. D. Card. GAMBERINI (LF86446). That Italian audience record is the secretary’s recording of a papal approval in the third person within his publication, without a Latin ex audientia formula; it is not separated as a papal act. LF86387–86399 (sheet signature, scan specks '$', 'f', 'F)', 'é', page number 545) are furniture inside the span.

XVI.’. The whole act LF90354–90810 and 20+ LF of context each side were read literally; native XML of leaves 587–590 was aligned line by line (exact on 588–590; leaf 587 differs only by the XML entity > in LF90368). HOLD for an exact substantive reading-order defect: raw LF90718 ‘segretario; ma le deliberazioni non potranno | nore per espresso e riferito di parola in parola,’ is a single XML LINE spanning both columns of leaf 590 (bbox [389,290,2483,359]). Its left half is the top line of the left column (§ 12 continues segretario; ma le deliberazioni non potranno / eseguirsi LF90721), but its right half ‘nore per espresso e riferito di parola in parola,’ is the top line of the right column, which belongs between LF90786 ‘quali cose tutte e singole, avendone qui il te-’ (bottom of the left column, bbox [378,3511,1393,3565]) and LF90789 ‘in quanto possano opporsi alla piena e totale’ (bbox [1463,344,2487,402]). Ordered nonoverlapping LF ranges can neither split nor move it: retaining LF90718 misplaces the derogatory clause’s words, excluding it drops the start of § 12’s sentence. No ordered derivative exists, so the complete motu proprio stays held as an extraction hold, not a fragment. LF90412 and LF90485 are XML textfloat LINEs in their correct order. Running titles and page/sheet numbers (LF90430 'I72', 90501, 90571, 90641 'D735', 90712, 90715) would be excludable furniture on a future admission.
